decision: Chose eu-west-1 because the jobs carry the customer list and ADR 0007 (in force) says customer data stays in the EU. Drafted a cross-repo ADR 0024 for Mira's rule that no customer name is ever written to a log.

recorded.info: Draft ADR (Proposed, key log-no-customer-names): nothing built in any repo or product may write a customer's name into a log; awaits Mira's confirmation and PR merge.
